source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The public 1958580 patch sets the message browser browsingContext sandbox flags before loadMessage, mirroring the named native mail-content policy. In the checked fixed source, the mask starts at 0xfffff and clears auxiliary-navigation, origin and user-activation top-level-navigation bits; the comment explains that flags prevent features. The native policy has its own mail-URL/allowed-content gates and resets the mask before those checks. The message error-page callback explicitly clears sandboxFlags before loading seeOtherURI. This supports only these named boundaries, not every current/future sandbox bit or all content paths. The same patch guards absent phishing link text; the old contentAreaClick.js path is absent at fixed revision. Both assigned discussions are denied, so private rationale and a runtime security outcome are unknown.
title: Apply the checked mail sandbox before loading the message URI
